scope: Read-only comparison of published preview inventory provenance with narrowly sampled official catalogue responses. No acquisition edits, record insertion or deployment mutation.

publishedPreview.accounting: The deployed snapshot accounts for all 4,089 entries in its recorded upstream inventory; its recorded source outcome is success. This does not establish freshest official inventory coverage.

officialCatalogueComparison.requestMethod: Four serial catalogue GETs, separated by at least 1,100 milliseconds. Native Node 24 fetch; clean approved source URL; 15-second abort deadline. All four had the same inventory digest and count.

implementationObservations: scripts/acquire.ts requests the official inventory once before crawling sitting records; it does not resample inventory before final staging.
Source fetch options currently contain redirect:manual and AbortSignal, without explicit cache mode or cache request headers.
The recorded raw inventory hashes differ despite an identical source build ID. Source response cache headers were not retained in the hosted public-preview artifact.

interpretation.confirmed: The preview is missing the newest sitting observed in local official reads, but fully accounts for its own captured 4,089-entry inventory. Different raw source inventory bytes were recorded by the hosted run.
interpretation.inference: Divergent or stale official CDN edge responses are a plausible explanation. This is not proven because hosted source response headers and original raw inventory bytes were not retained for inspection. A transient legitimate source response difference cannot be excluded.
interpretation.noStoreBoundary: Both local no-store reads remained CloudFront hits with the same 4,090-entry body as default reads. Adding no-store alone cannot be claimed to guarantee current origin inventory.
interpretation.publicationDecision: Retain the explicitly labeled public preview and disclose that it covers the captured inventory through 2026-10-07 and lacks the independently observed 2026-10-08 sitting. Freshest full-release acceptance remains pending. Do not insert the missing record manually or manufacture publication/source receipts.
